response.sql: SELECT account.district_id, COUNT(*) as num_accounts, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) as share FROM account GROUP BY account.district_id ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Share is expressed as a percentage (count/total × 100), a standard business interpretation of 'share'

alternatives.interpretation: Share is expressed as a decimal proportion (0–1) rather than a percentage
alternatives.sql: SELECT account.district_id, COUNT(*) as num_accounts, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) as share FROM account GROUP BY account.district_id ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;
